jamal: Heads up — saw a repeated perf spike (p99) on the SM farm when the kernel path switches for certain seq_len distributions. Collected a short trace and a microbench. TL;DR: KV cache churn + prefetch hint flip -> batching oscillation -> tail latency.

maya: saw the same on a dedicated pool at ~10:35 PT, p99 jumped from 160ms to ~420ms under the same workload. Only happened on models pinned to the new fp8-kv-fast path.

jamal: attaching the quick triage notes:
```
Summary:
- seq_len mix: 32x70%, 512x20%, 1024x10%
- Kernel route chosen: fp8-kv-fast (for SM>=86) when tensor cores present
- Observation: for mixed seqs, prefix caching misses cause kv cache churn; combined with prefetch hints kernel we see repeated cache invalidations
- Result: batcher reduces effective batch size repeatedly -> throughput drop + tail spike
```

cheng: @jamal can you paste the exact kernel hint flags? I want to repro locally.

jamal: sure — this is the runtime flag set we used for the canary: 
```
--kernel-prefer=tensorcore
--kv-prefetch=aggressive
--kv-cache-policy=adaptive
--seq-gating=autopick
```

lisa: we rolled the canary back to the conservative kernel (no aggressive prefetch) and the p99 dropped right away. Not a clean repro yet but rollback looks effective. :thumbsup:

inf-ra-bot: perf-run/2950004300 finished: compare baseline=1.3.6 vs candidate=1.3.7 -> delta p99 +160% on mixed seq workload (tag: kv-prefetch).

jamal: proposal: update autotuner heuristics to prefer kv-stable path when seq_len variance > 0.25 AND observed cache miss rate > 0.12 in a 30s window. Also add a cheap probe run to validate prefetch aggressiveness before flipping the hint. Pseudoconfig: 
```
heuristic {
  seq_variance_threshold: 0.25
  kv_miss_rate_threshold: 0.12
  probe_duration_sec: 10
  fallback_path: kv-stable-fp16
}
```

cheng: sounds good. I'd prefer to run experiment with 5% traffic first. Canary should exercise both short and long sequences. Also add a histogram metric for "kv_cache_evictions_per_minute".

maya: happy to run the 5% split and collect histogram + flamegraphs. I can do the microbench on the dedicated pool this afternoon.

jamal: I'll open the PR with the heuristic change and link perf diffs. PR will include a toggle so we can AB for 24h. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4287

lisa: one more ask — add a debug flag that logs kernel selection reason in traces (short tag) so we can correlate selection -> latency without full traces. keeps noise low.

jamal: yes, adding `kernel.reason` tag to sampling traces.

cheng: next steps: 1) jamal PR + toggle, 2) maya run 5% microbench, 3) infra to monitor kv eviction histogram and p99. Call out if we see oscillation within 10min windows.

maya: noted, starting runs at 15:00 PT. Will post results in this thread. :rocket:
